<style>
  /* Scaling wrapper: shrinks the fixed-size wheel to fit its column.
     The wheel is 800x800 intrinsic (640 + 80 padding each side).
     We scale it down and reserve height with an aspect-ratio box. */
  .ml-scaler {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 800px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;      /* reserve a square footprint that shrinks with width */
    position: relative;
    overflow: visible;
  }
  .ml-scaler-inner {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 800px;             /* intrinsic size of .ml-cycle incl. padding */
    height: 800px;
    transform-origin: top left;
    /* scale = containerWidth / 800; set via JS to stay responsive */
  }

  .ml-cycle {
    position: relative;
    width: 640px;
    height: 640px;
    padding: 80px;               /* room for edge circles to expand without clipping */
    box-sizing: content-box;
    overflow: visible;
    margin: 0;
  }

  /* ---- Primary step circles ---- */
  .ml-step {
    position: absolute;
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    margin: -75px 0 0 -75px;         /* center on anchor point */
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.25;
    padding: 10px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    transition: width 0.25s ease, height 0.25s ease, margin 0.25s ease,
                transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, z-index 0s;
    z-index: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .ml-step:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
  .ml-step:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #333; outline-offset: 3px; }

  .ml-step .step-num {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    opacity: 0.7;
  }
  .ml-step .step-label { font-size: 1.05rem; }

  /* Both content layers stay in the DOM; we crossfade opacity instead of
     toggling `display` (which can't animate and causes the jerky pop-in). */
  .ml-step .step-collapsed {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
    transition: opacity 0.12s ease;
  }
  .ml-step .step-expanded  {
    /* Stacked over the collapsed label, centered, hidden until open */
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 22px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.92);
    pointer-events: none;                 /* not interactive while hidden */
    transition: opacity 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease;
  }

  /* ---- Step positions (radius ~230 from 320,320) ---- */
  .step-1 { top: 170px; left: 400px; background: #dab7d3; }
  .step-2 { top: 338px; left: 619px; background: #999f24; }
  .step-3 { top: 592px; left: 528px; background: #bc83d3; }
  .step-4 { top: 592px; left: 272px; background: #b83912; color:#fff; }
  .step-5 { top: 338px; left: 181px; background: #7f1e15; color:#fff; }
  .step-4 .step-num, .step-5 .step-num { opacity: 0.85; }

  /* ---- Expanded state: grow the circle in place ---- */
  .ml-step.is-open {
    width: 300px;
    height: 300px;
    margin: -150px 0 0 -150px;
    z-index: 10;
    cursor: default;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    padding: 22px;
  }
  .ml-step.is-open .step-collapsed { opacity: 0; }

  /* Step 3 holds 8 dots + a page link, so it needs a bit more room */
  .ml-step.step-3.is-open {
    width: 340px;
    height: 340px;
    margin: -170px 0 0 -170px;
  }
  .ml-step.is-open .step-expanded  {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
    pointer-events: auto;
    /* Wait for the circle to finish growing (0.25s), then fade text in */
    transition: opacity 0.22s ease 0.20s, transform 0.22s ease 0.20s;
  }

  .step-expanded .exp-num {
    font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    opacity: 0.75; font-weight: 700;
  }
  .step-expanded .exp-title { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; margin: 2px 0 8px; }
  .step-expanded .exp-body  { font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .step-expanded .exp-link {

  .alg-grid {

    font-size: 0.58rem;

    padding: 4px;

    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);

  .alg-dot:hover { transform: scale(1.1); background: #8a3aa6; color:#fff !important; }

  /* ---- Center label ---- */
  .ml-center {
    position: absolute;
    top: 400px; left: 400px;
    width: 150px; height: 100px;
    margin: -50px 0 0 -75px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 2rem; color: #555;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
  }
  .ml-cycle.any-open .ml-center { opacity: 0; }

  /* ---- Mobile: stack columns, wheel goes full width and scales via JS ---- */

    .ml-scaler { max-width: 520px; }
  }

<script>
(function () {
  var cycle = document.getElementById('mlCycle');
  if (!cycle) return;
  var steps = Array.prototype.slice.call(cycle.querySelectorAll('.ml-step'));

  function closeAll() {
    steps.forEach(function (s) {
      s.classList.remove('is-open');
      s.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
    cycle.classList.remove('any-open');
  }

  function toggle(step) {
    var isOpen = step.classList.contains('is-open');
    closeAll();
    if (!isOpen) {
      step.classList.add('is-open');
      step.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      cycle.classList.add('any-open');
    }
  }

  steps.forEach(function (step) {
    step.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      // Let real links (algorithm dots, "Open page") and the close button behave
      var t = e.target;
      if (t.closest('a')) return;                 // link click → navigate
      if (t.closest('.exp-close')) { closeAll(); e.stopPropagation(); return; }
      toggle(step);
    });
    step.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggle(step); }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeAll(); }
    });
  });

  // Click outside to close
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('#mlCycle')) closeAll();
  });

  /* ---- Responsive scaling: fit the 800px wheel into its column ---- */
  var scaler = document.getElementById('mlScaler');
  var inner  = document.getElementById('mlScalerInner');
  function rescale() {
    var w = scaler.clientWidth;
    var s = w / 800;
    inner.style.transform = 'scale(' + s + ')';
  }
  rescale();
  window.addEventListener('resize', rescale);
  // Recheck after fonts/layout settle
  setTimeout(rescale, 100);
})();
</script>

::: {.column width="35%"}

The machine learning workflow is comprised of five steps, and often includes iteration after the last step to find optimal solutions.
Click on any of the steps to learn more.
The most important part of this process is something not listed: identifying your workflow's goal. This is done by completing relevant background research, talking to stakeholders, and identifying what data you have available to you.

Sometimes goals are not able to come to fruition. This is normal, and requires you to rescope your goal to something that is doable within your time frame.

:::
